desc.id: Peta dunia dengan gambar tanaman di enam wilayah tempat pertanian dimulai secara terpisah, seperti gandum di Asia Barat, padi di Tiongkok, pisang di Pulau Papua, dan jagung di Meksiko.

West Asia / wheat, barley, goats.note: Crops split over two lines ("gandum, jelai," / "kambing") and the whole label starts one line higher, because one line ran into the China label.

Mexico / maize, beans, squash.note: "labu" (squash) isn't in the Indonesian lesson text.

Andes / potatoes.note: The lesson says "Pegunungan Andes"; that ran off the left edge of the picture, so the label keeps "Andes" as the English does.

Farming began in many places, at differe.id: Pertanian dimulai di banyak tempat pada waktu yang berbeda.
Farming began in many places, at differe.back: Farming began in many places at different times.

World map with crop pictures in six regi.back: A world map with pictures of crops in six regions where farming began separately, such as wheat in West Asia, rice in China, bananas on the island of New Guinea (Papua), and maize in Mexico.
